text.p: Norfolk Southern is expected to acquire more than half of Conrail's routes and spend at least $700 million more than originally thought in splitting Conrail and CSX Corp, the Wall Street Journal said on Thursday.

Railroads CSX and Conrail on March 7 agreed to a $10.3 billion revised merger agreement which enabled CSX to negotiate a division of Conrail with Norfolk Southern. Norfolk had pursued a hostile takeover battle for Conrail.
Under the breakup terms, Norfolk Southern was seen getting at least 57 pecent of Conrail's northeastern U.S. rail system, the paper said, citing people familiar with the matter.
Norfolk would spend about $5.9 billion acquiring its Conrail share and CSX would spend about $4.4 billion, the paper said. None of the companies was immediately for comment.
The Journal said an announcement was expected within a week.
